messages.text: Moore inducted into Hall of Fame

metadata.summary: Ryan Moore paid tribute to the "brilliant people" who have helped build his magnificent career in the saddle after it was announced he has been inducted into the British Racing Hall of Fame.
metadata.content: Ryan Moore inducted into British Racing Hall of Fame | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Ryan Moore inducted into British Racing Hall of Fame Ryan Moore paid tribute to his family, Richard Hannon, Sir Michael Stoute and Aidan O'Brien after being announced as the British Racing's Hall Of Fame's newest member; The 42-year-old will be officially inducted on October 17 at Ascot's British Champions Day meeting Monday 5 October 2026 13:51, UK Ryan Moore paid tribute to the "brilliant people" who have helped build his magnificent career in the saddle after it was announced he has been inducted into the British Racing Hall of Fame. The three-time champion jockey, who has ridden an astonishing 230 Group/Grade One winners during a highly decorated career, will be honoured in an official ceremony at Ascot on Qatar Racing British Champions Day on October 17. The Aga Khan's ill-fated Shergar will be inducted on the same day. Moore was keen to namecheck those who have helped him build from his initial rides as a jump jockey for his father Gary to globetrotting international superstar. metadata.summary: Luke Humphries says his World Grand Prix triumph has left him feeling ready to win a second World Championship - and hopes to face Luke Littler in the final.
metadata.content: Luke Humphries hoping to face Luke Littler in World Championship final after ending major drought at World Grand Prix | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Luke Humphries hoping to face Luke Littler in World Championship final after ending major drought at World Grand Prix Luke Humphries claims first major title since 2025 Premier League with comeback victory over Gerwyn Price; World Grand Prix trophy puts 'Cool Hand' outright fifth on list of all-time PDC major winners; watch Grand Slam of Darts live on Sky Sports from November 14 Monday 5 October 2026 11:26, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from the World Grand Prix final where Luke Humphries recovered from 3-0 down to beat Gerwyn Price 6-4 in Leicester Luke Humphries says his World Grand Prix triumph has left him feeling ready to win a second World Championship - and hopes to face Luke Littler in the final. Humphries landed a first major title since the 2025 Premier League as he recovered from 3-0 down to beat Gerwyn Price 6-4 in the final of the double-start event, sealing victory with an 11-darter having broken his opponents in 10 to clinch the ninth set. 'Cool Hand' defeated Littler to win the 2024 World Championship and last year's Premier League but has lost his last four major finals against 'The Nuke', including at the 2025 World Grand Prx. metadata.summary: Heimir Hallgrimsson has called on UEFA to keep Ireland and Israel apart in future.
metadata.content: Republic of Ireland: Heimir Hallgrimsson calls on UEFA to keep Ireland and Israel apart in future after tense draw | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Republic of Ireland: Heimir Hallgrimsson calls on UEFA to keep Ireland and Israel apart in future after tense draw Republic of Ireland drew 1-1 with Israel in a behind-closed-doors contest in Serbia; there were allegations of spitting by an Israeli player at half-time, while the Israeli government criticised the Irish players for bowing their heads during the national anthem Monday 5 October 2026 09:03, UK Image: Ireland's head coach Heimir Hallgrimsson has called for UEFA to keep his team and Israel separate in future Heimir Hallgrimsson has called on UEFA to keep Ireland and Israel apart in future. The Ireland boss was speaking following his side's 1-1 UEFA Nations League draw with Israel behind closed doors in Serbia. The games between the two nations this international break were overshadowed by politics , with the Football Association of Ireland (FAI) urged to boycott the internationals amid ongoing conflict in the Israel-Gaza War. This continued in Serbia, as Ireland fitness coach Damien Doyle was allegedly spat on by an Israeli player at half-time, according to reports in the stadium. Irish media reported that the incident took place as the teams went down the tunnel. messages.text: McDermott explains Connor exclusion and England's World Cup game plan

metadata.summary: Brian McDermott has consistently talked about England having a "point of difference" in the Rugby League World Cup but eyebrows were raised when the head coach opted to leave Jake Connor out of the squad again.
metadata.content: England's Rugby League World Cup squad: Brian McDermott explains Jake Connor exclusion, Mikey Lewis inclusion, and game plan | Rugby League News | Sky Sports Skip to main content England's Rugby League World Cup squad: Brian McDermott explains Jake Connor exclusion, Mikey Lewis inclusion, and game plan England head coach Brian McDermott has named his 23-player squad for the upcoming Rugby League World Cup; He has chosen to leave Jake Connor out, citing big game experience and the 'game model' that England want to play with Megan Wellens Sports Journalist @MegWellensX Monday 5 October 2026 11:08, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Super League Grand Final between Warrington Wolves and Wakefield Trinity. Brian McDermott has consistently talked about England having a "point of difference" in the Rugby League World Cup but eyebrows were raised when the head coach opted to leave Jake Connor out of the squad again. Connor was controversially left out of England's 3-0 Ashes drubbing last autumn by then head coach Shaun Wane and has once again had a strong season for Leeds Rhinos that led to his Dream Team inclusion. However, McDermott has opted for George Williams, Harry Smith, and Mikey Lewis as his half-back options, with Sydney Roosters centre Hugo Savala also a capable half-back.
